# datannur

> Open-source, lightweight and sovereign data catalog. datannur scans data
> sources (files, databases, folder trees), generates metadata and builds a
> structured, interoperable catalog that runs in a browser — no heavy
> infrastructure, no vendor lock-in. Developed in Switzerland, in production
> for over two years in a cantonal statistical office.

datannur has two parts: the app (the catalog interface, a static web app)
and the builder (a Python package that scans sources and produces the
metadata feeding the catalog). Metadata stays under the organization's
control, in reusable formats. Target users: public administrations,
statistical offices, open-data teams, SMEs, NGOs, universities, BI/data
teams, and the consultants who support them.

The website is available in English (default), German (/de/), French (/fr/)
and Italian (/it/); every page exists in the four languages.

## Main pages

- [Overview](https://datannur.com/overview/): why data catalogs matter and the datannur approach
- [Structure](https://datannur.com/structure/): the catalog concepts (folder, dataset, variable, tag...) and how they relate
- [Features](https://datannur.com/features/): search, filtering, tree view, AI assistant, lineage, statistics, favorites, interoperability
- [Data ingestion](https://datannur.com/data-ingestion/): how the builder scans sources and feeds the catalog
- [Geodata](https://datannur.com/geodata/): cataloguing geographic data
- [Demo](https://datannur.com/demo/): try datannur online
- [Partners](https://datannur.com/partners/): the partner ecosystem (consultants, integrators)
- [Support](https://datannur.com/support/): vendor support plans
- [Project](https://datannur.com/project/): origins, open-source approach and vendor model
- [Contact](https://datannur.com/contact/): email, phone, GitHub

## Documentation

- [Documentation portal](https://datannur.com/documentation/): entry point, app vs builder
- [App documentation](https://docs.datannur.com/app/): install, configure and use the catalog interface
- [Builder documentation](https://docs.datannur.com/builder/): the Python metadata scanner
